_about: Material Symbols names for navigation.json, kept here because the phase list in that file is contested and gets superseded by merges while these do not. iconSpan() in src/ui/icon.js reads entry.sym; index.html's icon_names= subset must list every value used here or that tile renders nothing. Keys are entry ids.
REAPPLIED onto the five upstream stages at merge 2e9ec03. The map's
`preproduction` is upstream's `preprod`; the `screenplay` stage is new
and took edit_note. All 43 entries carry a sym.
A MISSPELT SYMBOL NAME DOES NOT FAIL — it silently serves the WHOLE
1.2MB face instead of a ~14KB subset. Google's API answers 200 either
way, so neither the status code nor the page will tell you. Measured:
one real name returns about 2KB, a bogus one returns 1,216,724 bytes.
Verify any new name by requesting it alone and looking at the SIZE,
and remember index.html's icon_names= list must gain it too.
A PHASE'S `hue` MUST EQUAL ITS `id`, and that is load-bearing rather
than tidiness. FIVE sites emit the .sh-ph-* class: shell.js twice,
launcher.js, panel.js — all four from `phase.hue` — and palette.js,
which builds it from `phase.id`. So if the two ever diverge, the
command palette renders grey while every other surface is correct and
nothing errors, because an undefined CSS variable fails silently by
design. Verified at 2e9ec03: all five stages satisfy it, and every
class the app can emit has a rule in tokens.css.
